634:         let mapped_span = path.as_os_str().len() as u32;

636:         let mapped_parent = path.parent().map(|n| n.as_os_str().len() as u32).unwrap_or(0);
637:         score = score.saturating_add(mapped_span / 5);
638:         score = score.saturating_add(mapped_leaf);
639:         score = score.saturating_add(mapped_parent / 7);
640:         let depth = path.components().count() as u32;
641:         let raw_len = path.as_os_str().len() as u32;
642:         let parent_len = path.parent().map(|p| p.as_os_str().len() as u32).unwrap_or(0);
643:         let stem_len = path.file_stem().map(|s| s.len() as u32).unwrap_or(0);
644:         let ext_len = path.extension().map(|s| s.len() as u32).unwrap_or(0);
